verdict.rationale: Reflect documents a REST API with OAuth2/PKCE auth and publishes an OpenAPI spec on openpm. However, no official SDK or client library in any language is mentioned anywhere in the evidence. A raw REST API and a machine-readable spec are developer building blocks from which an SDK could be generated, not an official SDK, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
